guard: a chat session's name is --name, else the saved name preference, else the account name in user mode or the OS login in open and static mode, with no suffix and no fallback across modes; every name is held to one rule; a name in use is found ignoring case
why: An agent reaches the human by name only when the name is stable and the human's to choose. Each mutation restores one way it was not: the random host suffix, a saved name that is ignored, a user-mode login problem hidden behind the OS login, a name with control characters, and a shared name missed because its letter case differs. The suite imports the workspace source, so no build is needed.

mutations.name: the resolver appends a host suffix to the OS login
mutations.expectRed: an open space names the session the OS login, with no host or suffix
mutations.cell: an open space names the session the OS login, with no host or suffix

mutations.name: the resolver ignores the saved name
mutations.find: else if (chosen) found = { name: chosen.value, source: "preference", from: "your saved name" };
mutations.expectRed: a saved name wins over the OS login
mutations.cell: a saved name wins over the OS login

mutations.name: user mode falls back to the OS login when the sign-in cannot name the session
mutations.replace: else if (target.mode === "user") found = await accountName(target).catch(() => ({ name: (opts.login ?? osLogin)(), source: "login" as const, from: "your OS login" }));
mutations.expectRed: no cached login refuses as AUTH_REQUIRED naming the login command, with no OS-login fallback
mutations.cell: no cached login refuses as AUTH_REQUIRED naming the login command, with no OS-login fallback

mutations.name: the name rule admits control characters
mutations.expectRed: an empty, blank, 129-character or control-character name is refused with the rule
mutations.cell: an empty, blank, 129-character or control-character name is refused with the rule

mutations.name: nameInUse compares case-sensitively
mutations.expectRed: live holders of the name in another letter case are found, each with its kind
mutations.cell: live holders of the name in another letter case are found, each with its kind
